data.name: Aaftaab
data.gender_notes: Aaftaab is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Persian āftāb (آفتاب) 'sun, sunshine', from āb 'water' + tāb 'shine, heat' - literally 'that whose heat/light is like water'. Borrowed into Urdu and used as a given name. Aaftaab therefore means “Sun; sunshine; sunlight”. Persian noun āftāb 'sun, sunshine'; used as a male given name in Persian and Urdu.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaftaab expresses “The Spreader”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Persian āftāb (آفتاب) 'sun, sunshine', from āb 'water' + tāb 'shine, heat' - literally 'that whose heat/light is like water'. Borrowed into Urdu and used as a given name.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaftaab total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
